interpretation: The long-range fraction is a NECESSARY check, not a sufficient one. Beating the sequence-proximity baseline is arithmetic - its long-range fraction is 0 by construction - and a uniformly random edge set scores near the random_edge_control figure here without carrying any structure. Read the head against the RANDOM control, and treat even that as evidence only that the edges are non-local. Whether they are CORRECT needs precision_vs_structure, which requires --true-contacts-dir (R2-13).
